concept.reason: Actual reconstructed mount photo and explicit skeletal drawing plus original anatomy text support form; extra concepts unnecessary.

classification: Dinosauria, Ornithischia, Thyreophora; early branching non-eurypodan
scope: Original whole lightly built biped dotted with numerous small scutes.

scale.basis: NHM approximate genus length, not a measured reconstruction of one specimen. NPS approximately4feet agrees; UMD1.5m not adopted.

specimen_basis: MNA.V.175 relatively complete postcranium and cranial fragments, 2021 primary text. Actual NPS photo is a reconstructed skeletal mount, not untouched fossil. Hartman2016 drawing is reconstruction, not photograph.
diagnostic_targets: Slender biped with short forelimbs held above ground, stronger long hindlimbs and horizontal trunk.
Very long tapering tail about half or more total length; no club or thagomizer.
Small elongate narrow herbivorous head, modest snout and closed mouth; no head horns.
Numerous small low keeled scutes across neck trunk flanks and tail, not enormous stegosaur plates or fused shell.
Tiny hands face medially, articulated hind feet and leg transitions; retain visible spaces between limbs.
uncertainties: Holotype has at least304 disarticulated osteoderms, exact life positions unknown. Lowpoly small-scute arrangement is reconstruction not measured original rows.
Photo mount includes restored elements. No claim direct original fossil inspection; original paper figure captions/text read but photo files could not be acquired.
Head incomplete; fleshy outline, skin colours inferred.
NPS narrative permits quadrupedality but2021 primary locomotor analysis supports biped; follow primary and original requested target.

Manual and pedal elements are incomplete/disarticulated. Five small manual digit forms and three principal toes plus reduced medial toe are stylized reconstructions, not a complete articulated specimen. Osteoderm shapes are simplified low-keeled forms rather than replicas of each published morphotype.
acceptance_checks: Complete light biped with short suspended forelimbs, long hindlimbs and tail.
Small numerous low scutes readable in side/top views.
No giant plates, tailclub, broad heavy ankylosaur body.
handoff_contract: Same directory prep maker QA. COMPLETE fixedhash stops. Root async backup; local-first integration; no maker upload cleanup.

render_profile.final: four exact-GLB views, 1024px, Cycles CPU, 2 threads; perspective reused as preview
render_profile.gray: four 512px exact-GLB views before final rendering

claim_scope: Original stylized anatomical reconstruction candidate; independent visual/factual acceptance pending. No GPU, populated-scene, user acceptance or deployment claim.

runtime_profile.materials: opaque untextured PBR metallic=0, roughness=.86; no extensions

anatomical_build_notes.origin: Center of the modeled low foot-contact footprint, at ground Z=0. Root remains identity.
anatomical_build_notes.mesh_structure: Eight editable semantic mesh objects composed of closed solids. Anatomical attachment overlaps are intentional; not a single boolean union or 3D-printing claim.
